functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive list of all available services and applications, including detailed descriptions and requirements, for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to offer a full range of information for applicants to research and select services, ensuring that all necessary details are available.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately display the eligibility criteria and application requirements for each service or application, with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and up-to-date information to guide applicants in selecting the right services or applications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load service and application details within 2 seconds for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves providing information to users, and a fast response time is essential for a good user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory per user session when displaying service and application details.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is important to ensure the system can handle a large number of users without performance degradation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for searching and filtering services and applications, with easily identifiable options and categories.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to be user-friendly, making it easy for applicants to find and understand the available options.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide tooltips and help text for all interactive elements, ensuring that new users can understand how to use the system within 5 minutes of first use.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a wide range of users, and a system that is easy to learn will enhance user satisfaction and efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a progress indicator and confirmation messages when users initiate an application, ensuring they are aware of the status and next steps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a multi-step process, and clear feedback will keep users engaged and informed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for 99.9% of the operational time to ensure that applicants can access and use the system when needed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the system, which is crucial for the application process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user data, including application details and personal information, using AES-256 encryption both at rest and in transit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user information, which must be protected to ensure privacy and compliance with data protection regulations.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide all necessary tools and features for staff members to create, edit, and format reports, including text editing, table creation, and image insertion, for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a comprehensive set of tools to support the development of staff reports, ensuring that all necessary features are available.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that all reports generated are free from formatting errors and data inconsistencies, with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate and professional reports, which are critical for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must save and publish reports within 5 seconds for documents up to 100 pages in length.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves the creation and publication of reports, and a fast response time is essential for productivity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 200 MB of memory per user session when creating and editing reports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is important to ensure the system can handle multiple users and large documents without performance issues.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for creating and editing reports, with easily identifiable tools and options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to be user-friendly, making it easy for staff members to create professional reports.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a comprehensive help guide and context-sensitive help, ensuring that new users can create a report within 15 minutes of first use.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a range of users with varying levels of expertise, and a system that is easy to learn will enhance user satisfaction and efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide real-time previews and auto-saving features to ensure that staff members can see the report as it will appear when published and make changes without losing work.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a detailed editing process, and real-time feedback will enhance user engagement and reduce errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for 99.9% of the operational time to ensure that staff members can create and publish reports when needed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the system, which is crucial for the report creation and publication process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all report data, including drafts and final versions, using AES-256 encryption both at rest and in transit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive organizational information, which must be protected to ensure privacy and compliance with data protection regulations.
